newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CHINA FIRM WANTS DAMAGES FOR DELAY IN LANKA PROJECT.
newsitem.headline: CHINA FIRM WANTS DAMAGES FOR DELAY IN LANKA PROJECT.

text.p: A Chinese firm is claiming 40 million rupees in damages from the Sri Lanka government over a delay in the construction of a local hospital, the independent Sinhalese-language newspaper Lankadeepa said on Tuesday.

It said the China National Complete Plant Import & Export Corp had been contracted to construct a new building for Colombo's Lady Ridgway Children's Hospital under a concessional Chinese government loan of 420 million rupees.
But there has been a 17-month delay in handing the construction site to the Chinese company because parts of the existing building were still to be demolished, the newspaper said. ($1 = 58.8 rupees)
